title: Per-file-only upload preflight block dead-ends the documents step with zero visible message — the hold's banner scroll is a no-op because no banner exists on that branch
detail: One >5MB photo under the 22MB aggregate: form.js sets data-preflight-blocked via setSubmitDisabled(anyPerFile) but shows no banner (showBanner is aggregate-only) and the inline per-file span stays display:none. Stepper gating passes (file staged), the hold fires, banner querySelector returns null on a pristine page, and Continue silently does nothing. Applicant is stuck with no explanation.
recommended_fix: In the hold branch, when banner is null, reveal the section's non-empty .field-error[data-preflight-error="true"] spans (style.display="flex") before returning — or ship the deferred form.js showInlineError display fix.
